item.title: Five Poems -- Handle on the Windows
item.description: In camera, a single wavering, A flicker flying to me As I try to capture Movements of images past, Something like a memory, But only going in one direction, A sudden recall of the source? Impossible or else broken, This must be a train, or life Finally busy enough to be lived.

item.title: Five Poems -- At Fitzgerald's Grave
item.description: I have taken my martini communion, One for me, then another for you, They buried your body in a dry town, I had to sniff out a happy hour. They laid you to rest with the faithful, Your daughter said you were one And so there you are now, In a cemetery among Catholic pioneers. An older Fitzgerald rests beside you, A younger one at your feet, In this lot, I could throw out a rock, And hit another oneandrsquo;s tombstone. item.title: Five Poems -- Through the Fire Screen
item.description: All my watching is remote, No idea how to make Anything peaceful happen Unless I refuse to roam. My eyeballs can move, My eyelids can blink, My nostrils can flare, of course, This is not a suicide pact. Most of my movements Remain off limits, otherwise I find myself a drug In a world of bad interactions.

item.title: Five Poems -- Peakward Enterprises
item.description: Attention please, I crave Your indulgence, Deposit your knees and fingers, Open wide your screens, And let your eyes run wild Over all my offers I proffer you. The national lottery has chosen You or this account To be a vessel for my focus, I see the skeptical twist Of your eyebrow in reflection, I want to bring you compensation. item.title: Five Poems -- A Little Bit of Solid
item.description: Swirling through a galaxy, I look for stars But can only stop for the stoplights, They change from one color to another And I admit, in the humidifier of late autumn mist, They glitter like giant balls of gas That are momentarily traveling on vacation. But once the shift from ruby goes through Into emerald I roll on and leave The limitation of the intersection behind, In the distance another barrier Glitters away and I decide to declare this proof Of the theory that there is a milky way for us.
